title: The Getty Kouros Colloquium
source_type: primary institutional symposium proceedings / technical examination
book_use: Chapter 10 - authentication dispute, scientific surface analysis, and unresolved multidisciplinary judgment
claim_boundary: The Getty convened nineteen scholarly/scientific contributions around the authenticity question. Frank Preusser's technical examination reports that early work emphasized dedolomitization, while later analysis found the 10-50 micron alteration layer was mostly calcium oxalate monohydrate (whewellite), with soil/iron oxide and calcite; artificial oxalic-acid treatment could make whewellite but did not reproduce the observed layer's complexity. The proceedings did not settle the statue's authenticity. Use this source to show that the scientific evidence itself became more complex, not that laboratory analysis was simply disproved.
